intentAndPurpose.intent: Icon-only toggle button (like / favourite pattern). Toggle sibling of IconButton. The unselected state is always a muted ghost; `attention` (high/medium/low) drives the selected-state prominence (bold fill / subtle fill / ghost-with-accent-border). Supports 6 sizes, `1:1`/`2:3` shape, `condensed`, `contained`, `fullWidth`, `disabled`, and `loading` (busy, non-disabled). Controlled via `selected`/`onSelectedChange` or uncontrolled via `defaultSelected`. `aria-label` is required.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph to render — a SemanticIconName, a ReactElement, or an IconComponent (e.g. icon={IcStar}).

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (the toggle pressed state).

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Fires with the next boolean selected state.

props.name: value
props.description: Value for a selection group (parity — passthrough for a future native ToggleGroup).

props.name: attention
props.description: Prominence of the SELECTED state: high→bold fill, medium→subtle fill, low→ghost with accent border. Unselected is always muted ghost.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size — f-step number (4|6|8|10|12|14) or t-shirt alias (2xs–xl). Default 10 (M).

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent role. Explicit non-'auto' wins; otherwise resolves to 'primary'.

props.name: shape
props.description: Square (1:1) or wide rectangle (2:3). Contained only.

props.name: contained
props.description: When true (default), a contained icon chip with background/border. When false, a bare icon (no background/border/box); condensed/fullWidth/shape are ignored.

props.name: condensed
props.description: Reduces the container size while keeping the icon size. Contained only.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill container width. Contained only.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner replacing the icon and marks the control busy. Activation is suppressed while busy, but it is NOT marked disabled.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler (React Native convention).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Web parity alias for onPress.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible label — icon-only controls need an accessible name.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Describes the result of toggling (React Native).

props.name: testID
props.description: React Native test identifier.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: [error] Don't paint directly. Use `appearance` (role) + `variant`/`mode` and wrap in <Surface mode>; the brand cascade picks the right fill.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout style only. attention + appearance + the parent <Surface> drive bg / icon colour — do not paint here. — [warn] SelectableIconButton colour is surface-resolved from `attention` + `appearance`. Don't set backgroundColor; wrap in <Surface> and it adapts automatically.
